title: The Ringer’s Zach Lowe this week brought up a Murray …
text:
The Ringer’s Zach Lowe this week brought up a Murray … Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS The Ringer’s Zach Lowe this week brought up a Murray …
 HoopsHype Nov. 9, 2026, 4:36 a.m. ET The Ringer’s Zach Lowe this week brought up a Murray trade as a potential escape hatch in Denver, a “surprise” trade candidate. As he said, “If this team isn’t good, I think something is gonna crack here. I’m not closing the door.” Murray is off to an excellent start, again averaging 25.4 points this season, and making 47.4% of his shots and 50.9% (!) of his 3-pointers. With three years and $161 million on his contract, he is not an easy guy to trade. But Lowe is right–if things go South for this team, his name could crop back up in late January, or next summer.
